csv_agency: City of Des Moines, Public Works
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Des Moines is requesting statements of qualifications for firms interested in providing design and right-ofway (ROW) services for the 24th Avenue South Improvements Project - Segment 1. The 24th Ave South Improvements Project - Segment 1 is located primarily on 24th Ave S, between S 223rd St and S 216th St. The project will construct curb, gutter, sidewalks and bike lanes on both sides of 24th Ave S from S 223rd St to S 216th St matching existing improvements that continue to the north and south of the project limit.
